title: The 18:00: open with the 12:00's follow-ups, then four decisions (two pairs are one decision each)
detail: 21 decisions open, all with Dinis in them except one. (1) Open with the nine follow-ups from the 12:00 record (WS-96, each with an owner): is each moving? (2) Two pairs are the same decision, so decide each once: the outreach (WS-26: the 18:00 item 'approve the emails' one claim' and the 12:00 item '28 emails waiting for Dinis's yes'), and the merch on Monday (WS-48: 'Dinis collects by car, or...' and 'garments: who collects, the receipt holder'; plus Jose's navy question). (3) Meet transcripts to the record (WS-98, Dinis, Angelo, Jose): team-collaboration's scheduled runs can read Angelo's Drive, where Meet saves the stand-ups' transcripts. (4) Then the ranked rest: the GitHub invitations (WS-09), who records (WS-107), Daniela's setup (WS-125). Strip: 72 late, 49 with no owner, 37 due today. Say each as 'decided: <item>: <words>'.
